tutorial_home_text:
This app helps you easily and quickly manage all the expenses of an event.

An activity can be:
   🔹 Personal, when you want to keep track of your own expenses
   🔹 Group, when multiple people participate, and you want to know the total expense and the settlements among participants

🔹 Multi-Location and Multi-Currency:
Enter expenses in the local currency (EUR, USD, JPY...) and the app converts everything into your main currency.

🔹 Everything is automated:
You just need to enter the expenses you incur.

🔹 Tutorial:
On pages where available, clicking the info icon will show you the tutorial dedicated to that page.
tutorial_event_view_text:
In these pages you can manage the costs of the ongoing activity:

   🔹 Enter your Expenses
   🔹 Enter your Transfers
   🔹 View Charts

If you created the activity, you will need to manage its configuration: enter locations, currencies, expense accounts, and the participating people.
tutorial_event_edit_text:
Before configuring the activity, complete the support tables:

- Locations
- Currencies
- People

Once these tables are filled out, enter the other activity details.
tutorial_localita_text:
Locations indicate the places where activities take place.

They help you better organize expenses and understand where costs were incurred.
tutorial_valute_text:
Here you can add the currencies used in the event.

They are used to record expenses in foreign currency and keep accurate accounts among participants.
tutorial_gruppi_text:
Expense Accounts organize the activity's expenses.

You can associate one or more People to the same account when they share the same expenses.
Example: "Husband & Wife" on a single shared account.

Each Person enters expenses and transfers into their assigned Expense Account.

The app automatically calculates:
   🔹 Total Expense, Per Capita
and for each Account:
   🔹 Paid, Owed, and Settlement
tutorial_persone_text:
People are participants associated with Expense Accounts, authorized to record expenses and transfers.

When you add a Person for the first time:
   🔹 Enter their name and mobile number.
   🔹 The app saves them, associates them with the Expense Account, and adds them to your internal address book.

Next time, you'll just need to start typing the name and select it from the list without re-entering the details.

The app automatically calculates:
    🔹 The Total of registered People
    🔹 The Number of Participants associated with the Account.
tutorial_spese_text:
Here you can record expenses related to the event activity.
Enter the amount, category, location, and who paid: the app updates everything automatically.
